title: Mood and energy log
audience: For anyone who wants to see what lifts them and what drains them.
description: An evening check-in that colours your month by mood and shows what lifts you and what drains you. Log it in the app, or tell your AI about your day.
tagline: An evening check-in that shows patterns.
seoTitle: Mood and energy log template for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
Mood and energy log

Log each evening in the app: mood and energy from 1 to 5, hours slept, a tag or two and a line about the day. The month shows as a calendar, and Trends shows what goes with your better days. Or tell your AI about your day and it logs it.

## Patterns
What your AI notices when you ask it to look back.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Mood and energy log". It is an app; its data is "Mood and energy log.app/data.json", beside the note. Read it with fetch before each change; change it with edit. When I tell you about my day, set values.days[date] (yyyy-mm-dd, today unless I say otherwise) to { mood, energy, sleep, tags, note }: mood and energy from 1 (low) to 5 (great), sleep in hours the night before, tags from values.tags (add a new one there too), note one short line in my words. If a score is unclear, ask me; don't guess. Keep earlier days. When I ask about patterns, answer from values.days with averages and the days each rests on; add what you notice under "Patterns" in the note. Don't give medical advice.

asks: Ask how my day went and how I slept, then log today.
Slept 6 hours, mood 3, energy 2, long day at work.
How has my energy been on days I exercise?

args.old_string: What your AI notices when you ask it to look back.
args.new_string:
What your AI notices when you ask it to look back.
- Energy follows sleep: 1.8 on average after nights under 6 hours (5 days), 3.4 after 7 hours or more (27 days).
- Mood is 4.2 on the 12 days you exercised and 3.2 on the 29 without.
- Work stress days: mood 2.7 (13 days), against 3.8 on the rest. Worth another look in a month.
